description: Arribo y zarpe de buques 2024 al 2026 is a dataset listed in Dominican Republic national open data portal (datos.gob.do), an open data portal, published or maintained by Cuerpo Especializado de Seguridad Portuaria (CESEP). Este conjunto de datos contiene la relación de los arribos y zarpes de los buques en los puertos nacionales e instalaciones portuarias, del año 2024 al 2026 en el cual se pueden encontrar (Los Puertos, Salida y Entrada, Cantidad, Mes y Año). Coverage: República Dominicana. The portal files it under the publisher Cuerpo Especializado de Seguridad Portuaria (CESEP). Its tags are CUERPO ESPECIALIZADO EN SEGURIDAD PORTUARIA CESEP. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV, ODS, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-07-20 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-do-portal.
